result.title: Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
result.summary: Harness optimization improves long-horizon agents by refining the prompts, tools, memory, and hooks around a frozen model. Offline methods can learn from completed trajectories, but deploy one shared harness that may overfit training tasks and cannot react to evidence revealed during a new run. Online evolution can adapt before, during, or after one run through an evolver, but may have to reason about every intervention from scratch or rely on verifier feedback that is usually unavailable at test time. We introduce Meta$^2$, which moves offline optimization one level up: rather than optimizing a shared harness, it learns reusable knowledge for harness evolution and applies it within each task online. Offline, Meta$^2$ learns a textual Meta-Skill $M$ by contrasting training rollouts of the same task agent under three configurations: without an evolver, with an evolver guided by the current version of $M$, and with an evolver given privileged verifier information available only in training. Contrasts in trajectories and outcomes are aggregated across tasks to refine $M$ into reusable guidance on when and how to evolve, when to leave the harness unchanged, and which interventions to avoid. Online, an evolver combines the frozen $M$ with emerging trajectory evidence to decide whether to KEEP the harness unchanged or EVOLVE it through a task-local edit. Each edit applies to the rest of the same run without resetting its environment or progress. Thus, evolution guidance transfers across tasks while harness edits remain task-local, and held-out verifier feedback is never available to the evolver. On two long-horizon benchmarks, Terminal-Bench 2.1 and DeepSWE 1.1, Meta$^2$ achieves the highest performance among evaluated methods with GPT-5.6-Terra, reaching 81.00% and 44.44%, respectively. Ablations support the value of contrastive evolution guidance and keeping online harness edits task-local.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Meta$^2$，将 harness 优化上移一层：离线对比三种配置（无 evolver、由当前 Meta-Skill 引导的 evolver、获得训练期特权验证器信息的 evolver）的 rollout，学习可复用的文本 Meta-Skill，在线由 evolver 结合轨迹证据决定保持 harness 不变还是在当前 run 内做局部修改，并在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与 DeepSWE 1.1 上报告所评估方法中的最佳成绩。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用对比式轨迹与特权验证信息蒸馏出「何时介入、何时不改、避免何种修改」的控制知识，可能为 LVR 中监督「何时更新 latent 推理状态或继续检索、何时停止」以及无验证器时的在线自适应提供可核查线索，但研究对象是纯文本 agent 的 harness，不涉及视觉表示。
